items.source: Process the specified PropertySourceDescriptor against the environment managed by this instance.
items.translation: 对指定的PropertySourceDescriptor类处理此实例管理的环境。

items.source: This class is stateful and merges descriptors with the same name in a single PropertySource rather than creating dedicated ones.
items.translation: 该类是有状态的，并在单个 `PropertySource` 中合并具有相同名称的描述符，而不是创建专用的描述符。

items.source: IOException - if loading the properties failed
items.translation: `IOException` - 如果加载属性失败

items.translation: Stephane Nicoll, Sam Brannen, Juergen Hoeller
